# Direct Energy

> > Direct Energy provides electricity and natural gas services to residential and commercial customers across multiple U.S. states and Canadian provinces.

Direct Energy operates as a retail energy provider serving business and residential customers with competitive energy products and services. The company maintains operations across multiple regulated markets including Texas (PUCT), Connecticut (CT PURA), Massachusetts (MA DPU), District of Columbia (DC PSC), and other states, offering contract management, pricing tools, and self-service portals for channel partners and business customers.
